newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Detained Palestinian accuses Israel of torture.
newsitem.headline: Detained Palestinian accuses Israel of torture.

text.p: A Palestinian student arrested by Israel two weeks ago has accused his interrogators of torturing him and appealed to the Jewish state's High Court to stop it, Israel Radio said on Thursday.

The radio said the High Court had set an emergency hearing for Friday on the petition by Mustafa Hassan Mohammed Abu Nasr from Jabalya refugee camp in the Gaza Strip. When arrested Abu Nasr was a student at Bir Zeit University in the West Bank.
The Israel courts spokesman was not available for comment.

In his petition Abu Nasr said he was made to sit on a low stool with a sack over his head, his arms stretched behind his back and his legs shackled and also hung for hours from his cell door, the radio said.
A 1987 Israeli commission ruled the Shin Bet secret police could use "moderate physical pressure" in interrogations and "increased physical pressure" when an attack was imminent.
Human rights groups have said the commission's report sanctioned torture, allowing interrogators to beat suspects, deprive them of sleep and tie them up in painful positions.
